heading: Product designer at InstaDeep
description:
* Collaborating on a design system to help accelerate new projects’ creation, and insure consistency across non-branded projects

* Creating fun animations and micro-interactions to make our products feel dynamic (which increased the wow! effect by 2 wows/user).

* Introduced tools like Rive, Lottie, and Framer, which helped us reduce developer frustration and reduce development time by up to one week on average.

* Redesigned a couple of products, improving the UX and modernizing the UI. Which for some projects, paired with great enhancement by the AI team, tripled the product usage over less than 1 year.

* Brought to life many innovative AI related projects.
title: Product designer
